The '''Mission to Taloraan''' was undertaken by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].

==History==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] to secure the shipment of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were unaware that magister of [[Taloraan City]], [[Orlin Denache]] secretly signed a treaty with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who was interested in making Taloraan a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]]. A [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Canteval]] was sent to the planet and lncal CIS supporters led by [[Rynert]] began to smuggle [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]] into the city.

Denache realized that the Jedi would detect his lies with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], so he pretended to became ill and his emissary [[Sech Govlinder]] was sent to negotiate in his place. After the first round of negotiations Ahsoka Tano went into the city and accidentally discovered [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stocked within a guarded warehouse. Canteval ordered the droids to attack her and the other Jedi, revealing the CIS presence within the city. Kenobi and Skywalker accused Govlinder of treachery and tried to reach their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class shuttle]], but were incapacitated when the shuttle was blown up and taken into custody.

Meanwhile, Ahsoka Tano managed to leave the city of [[Denfrandi]] and persuade a tribe of [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raiders]] to join combat against CIS forces. Govlinder himself felt manipulated by Denache and remained loyal to the Republic. Once he had the chance, he immediately freed both Jedi and returned to them their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Afterward he led them to the city's central communication tower, where the Jedi were able to patch a message to their [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Without the element of surprise Canteval's Munificent was unable to overpower the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator]] on its own. With its shield weakening, the Munificent took several direct hits into its engines and, unable to maintain altitude, was sucked into the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant's]] core.

Meanwhile, the ''Resolute'' has sent several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] with clone reinforcements to help the loyalists regain control of the city. Rynert and his followers tried to hold, but against the combined strength of the Jedi, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Denfrandi]] loyalists and the Wind Raiders they were outmatched and soon defeated. Facing a dead-end, magister Denache committed suicide by stepping off the edge of the city and falling into the care of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. Temporarily taking the rule of the city, Govlinder continued negotiations with the Jedi and acknowledged the support of the Wind Raiders, who also played a small part in the skirmish.
